decisions.reason: A hearty bread loaf builds directly on the bakery's core baking knowledge, so the firm can read its sales results and refine the recipe with little extra effort.
Sweet pastry sits squarely within the firm's existing competence, but pastry ranges rotate often, which raises the risk of replacement somewhat.
Crusty farmhouse bread is a staple that draws on the firm's established bread know-how and fits its traditional mill image.
The poppy seed stollen won a gold award and has its own page, which shows the firm can assess and use external quality feedback on this seasonal speciality.
The premium stollen's gold award validates it against external standards, and it builds on the firm's stollen expertise, making it a valuable seasonal flagship.
